subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella issue before more automated fixes are queued?
rationale: The current bug is real, but the permanent fix changes at-least-once delivery, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, and duplicate-prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable outbox or equivalent state machine before landing partial retry changes.

options.title: Narrow to linked retry PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as the near-term fix and require live proof plus follow-up issues for the remaining delivery races.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Close or demote this umbrella only after maintainers move each remaining failure mode to a clearly owned narrower issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable outbox or equivalent state machine before landing partial retry changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Most current blame and recent file history across the affected lifecycle and delivery files points to steipete as the best available routing owner for the product boundary decision.
